_about: Workflow metadata merged into the Draft 02 records by `python3 bg.py import`. The draft owns every prompt, reference, view, state and check; this file only adds the worker lane (family), the sample/anchor setup and which manuscript beats and insets each record serves (via the draft's reuse notes). Defaults: set=full, anchor=false, candidates=1. `_style_overlay` (the user's art direction, 2026-10-20) and any record's `clarify` text are added to every composed prompt at run time, so they apply to all images and survive re-imports.
_style_overlay: Art direction for every image: a hybrid of illustration and reality. Give real-world materials and construction photographic conviction (carved, weathered blue-painted timber with visible grain and joinery; dressed pale stone with worn edges; cast and brushed brass with patina; wrought ironwork; glass with true reflections) and true perspective and scale, while keeping an illustrator's composition, colour harmony and storybook warmth. Make the fair grand, mystic and magical: tall multi-storey architecture with rich cornices, brackets, balconies, finials and roofline spires, deep layered space, gentle moonlit haze, faint drifting motes of silver-gold light and, where the sky shows, a vast starry moonlit sky. Magic lives in atmosphere and craftsmanship only: never light a lamp, arch, track or indicator that the visual state keeps dark, and keep floors, benches and working areas clear and crisp. Exactly one moon, always full; no second moon, crescent moon or halo ring in the sky. No words on any sign, banner or board except labels this prompt names; leave other boards plain. In close-ups, grandeur comes from material richness, fine craftsmanship and light, with every task object sharp and readable. Outside the fair, the Mumbai street stays ordinary and real; the grandeur belongs to the fair.

001.clarify: The mirror alcove on the left holds a shallow square brass frame standing low, just above the paving and leaning slightly back; it is never an oval or a wall-hung mirror. The cube canopy stands against the right-hand wall, not out in the lane. The parked handcart is empty, with nothing stacked in or on it.
